source_name: Lean mathlib4 — explicit theorem and lemma proposition statements

official_access.access_mode: Resolve an exact mathlib4 Git commit, acquire the repository checkout on an external executor, and process Mathlib/**/*.lean in bulk. GitHub Actions must not perform acquisition, extraction, Parquet generation, or Internet Archive publication.

scope.corpus: The maintained Mathlib/**/*.lean mathematical library tree at one exact mathlib4 commit
structures: membership, order, algebraic and analytic relations
constraints and formal statements across algebra, analysis, topology, number theory, probability, combinatorics, geometry, computability and related mathematical domains
scope.original_representation: exact lexical Lean 4 proposition substring between a theorem/lemma declaration's result colon and its proof delimiter
scope.batching: one exact mathlib4 Git commit + deterministic Mathlib/**/*.lean source inventory per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: proof bodies are not equation occurrences in this lane
definitions, examples, axioms, syntax declarations and generated/rendered documentation are excluded from this first formal-statement lane
the extractor rejects theorem/lemma declarations without an explicit lexical proposition boundary
comments, normal/raw strings, character literals and Lean syntax quotations are masked only for declaration-boundary detection and never emitted as source attestations
no Lean-to-LaTeX translation, elaboration, theorem proving, algebraic normalization or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
Archive/, MathlibTest/, Batteries/ and vendored/dependency trees are outside this lane unless a later source contract audits them separately

snapshot_policy.rule: At run time resolve the selected official mathlib4 ref to its exact Git commit; acquire that commit outside GitHub Actions; SHA-256 every included Mathlib/**/*.lean source object; sort path/size/hash records deterministically; record the root LICENSE SHA-256; and use mathlib4:git:<commit>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. The descriptor does not hardcode a mutable current commit. A changed commit, file set or source byte inventory creates a new immutable snapshot and Internet Archive item.

license_policy.scope: mathlib4 repository work under Mathlib/**/*.lean at the selected commit
license_policy.rule: Verify the root LICENSE at the selected commit before harvest and retain Apache-2.0 notices/conditions with redistributed source-derived data. If the selected snapshot contains a NOTICE file or file-specific third-party rights notices relevant to included source, preserve them as required and fail closed for affected payloads until audited. Scope excludes dependency/vendor trees by default.

adapter.input: verified mathlib4 repository checkout containing Mathlib/ and the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE
validation: expression_original is the exact lexical Lean 4 proposition substring and is not a pretty-printed or LaTeX reconstruction
source snapshot must bind exactly to the supplied full Git commit and a 64-hex inventory digest
root LICENSE must contain Apache License Version 2.0 evidence and its SHA-256 is retained
nested block comments, line comments, normal/raw strings, character literals, backtick names and syntax quotations are excluded from declaration discovery
source_record_sha256 is independent of checkout directory and depends on source id, immutable snapshot, repository-relative path, document bytes, declaration ordinal/kind/name and proposition bytes
declarations without an explicit proposition + proof delimiter are rejected rather than guessed
proof bodies, OCR, prose reconstruction, Lean elaboration and semantic equivalence claims are excluded from extracted output
